messages.message:
Patch Set 3:

(1 comment)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good; the code removal itself checks out - LUSTRE_SET_SYNC_FL is unreachable (mdt_setattr_unpack_rec() masks sa_attr_flags with LUSTRE_FL_USER_MODIFIABLE, which does not contain 0x00040000) and nothing else in the tree references it. The one thing worth a refresh is the commit message, see inline.

sanity-quota test_55 already drives the exact unprivileged-chgrp path this patch changes. Extending it to set a chattr bit (e.g. chattr +A) on the file before the successful chgrp and check it is still there afterwards would lock in the new behaviour cheaply.

commit.message:
LU-15880 quota: remove unused LUSTRE_SET_SYNC_FL

Remove the LUSTRE_SET_SYNC_FL, which hasn't been set since the
quota GID changing fix in commit v2_11_56_0-178-g7b46ff54af.
Remove the accompanying LA_FLAGS setting that no longer has
any flags to pass, which also fixes a bug left in the code.
